thread:
maria: Quick design pass — can we do a focused review of the Batch -> Vectors preview panel? I sketched a couple options for layout and keyboard flows. attaching image in thread :point_down:

sam: thanks! can you paste the sketch here or a brief summary? I'm on mobile rn but want to flag the export copy question.

maria: sure — two variants: (A) compact table with inline relevance sparkbars and a right rail with a detail card; (B) larger card grid where each vector has copy + score badges. Key Qs: readability at 8 rows, how to surface rerank score, and CSV/JSON export headers.

ryan: my vote is table for dense lists — engineering prefers predictable columns for export. Card view feels nicer but harder to paginate/batch.

anya: accessibility nits on both: table must support header sorting via keyboard and aria-sort. Card grid needs focusable container + skip link. also color contrast for the score badges (current orange 3:1 fail).

kevin: +1 for table. also we need to show when vectors are sampled vs full batch. maybe a small chip like "sampled 10/100".

luisa: copy tweak: Export button should say "Export vectors (CSV/JSON)" not just "Export" — users confuse it with exporting the dataset. and tooltip: "Includes id, embedding, score, and metadata."

maria: notes: table columns: id | preview (first 120 chars) | embedding dim | rerank_score | metadata_count | actions. Rerank_score should be 0-1 with 3-decimal display and sparkbars inline.

sam: for CSV headers let's standardize: 
```
id,preview,embedding,rerank_score,metadata
```
Is embedding base64 or array? we need to pick one. engineering prefers array for local processing.

kevin: array is fine, but huge CSV cells are annoying. alternative: compression/export option: "embedding as base64" or "as JSON array". default to JSON array.

anya: Accessibility: table keyboard row actions — pressing Enter should open detail pane, not trigger first action. Need clear focus outline and an ARIA label for the relevance visualization. Also add aria-live region for export completion messages.

ryan: implementation detail: if we show sparkbars inside a table cell, ensure virtualization plays nicely. avoid complex DOM per row for performance. maybe render sparkbars in canvas.

luisa: Re: export copy: success toast should include a link: "Download 10 vectors" and a copyable S3 path if on Dedicated.

maria: UX question: When user filters by relevance threshold, should exported file include the filter metadata? Suggest adding a small header row comment or a companion file named "filters.json". Thoughts?

sam: include a companion metadata JSON. CSV comments are messy. +1.

kevin: product ask: include model and quantization in metadata too (e.g., model: text-embed-001, q: int8).

anya: accessibility quick check for export modal: make sure modal is focus-trapped and keyboard-esc closes it; on large exports show a progress bar and allow cancelling. progress bar should be ARIA role=progressbar with value.

maria: design update: I'll produce two quick mocks (table + compact card) and annotate keyboard flows and aria hints. Will also add the export modal copy and the companion filters.json example. target for mock: EOD tomorrow.

design-bot: Reminder: design review scheduled Thu 10am. Agenda: finalizing table header names, export format, A11y checklist.

ryan: one more thought — rerank column should let users re-sort by score desc/asc. small caret icon + aria-hidden on icon, aria-sort on header.

luisa: copy suggestion for rerank header: "Relevance (score)" to reduce ambiguity.

maria: perfect — I'll include that label in mocks. thanks all :tada:

sam: quick micro-nit — keyboard shortcut to toggle preview should be `v`. add to keyboard help.

anya: added to A11y checklist. I'll run contrast checks on badge colors and propose accessible palettes.

maria: ok wrapping up — action items: (maria) mocks + annotated accessibility notes; (kevin) confirm export format options with infra; (sam) confirm CSV size limits; (anya) run color/keyboard checklist; (ryan) feasibility of canvas sparkbars. I'll ping when mocks are ready.

kevin: noted. I'll check CSV limits and response size for download endpoint.

sam: thanks — will follow up after infra answers.

luisa: leaving a UX note: consider a "copy preview" button per row so users can quickly grab text for local rerank tests.

maria: good call — will add that as an inline action in mocks.

design-bot: Event: mock uploaded by maria at 1772223500

maria: uploaded mocks and a sample filters.json at 1772223500. please review and add comments in Figma.

anya: reviewing now. first pass: cards look nice but table is more scannable. leaving comments on contrast and focus order.

ryan: checked the mocks — quick thumbs up for table accessibility notes.

sam: +1. will loop infra and we can lock copy before Thu review.

kevin: thanks everyone.
